subject: English Home Language

source.topic: The sky (day and night): Emergent Writing
source.subtopic: Traces letter 'q' templates to make 'q' mobiles

show.line: Let's write q. Go round, then a long line down with a little flick. q, q, queen!

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says q, as in queen.
This letter says q. Say the sound!
Trace q with your finger. Round, then a long line down and a little flick.
Look carefully. Which one is q? Its tail flicks out.

hints: q is round with a long tail that flicks out.
Start at the top. Round, then down.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write q for queen.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Round, then down and curl like a hook. Look, I wrote q!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is g. The tail of q flicks the other way.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Round, then down with a little flick. That is q!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter q, say its sound and trace it.
